system.description:
The character is completely immune to attack damage and adverse effects from a particular weapon, element, or condition. Higher levels reflect broader or more impactful immunities.

  • Level 1: Rare role in game (e.g., sacred wood weapons, specific nemesis)
  • Level 2: Small role in game (e.g., silver weapons, specific group)
  • Level 3: Moderate role in game (e.g., iron weapons, demons, night)
  • Level 4: Large role in game (e.g., electricity, cold, weapon types)
  • Level 5: Major role in game (e.g., fire/heat, broad weapon types)
  • Level 6: Extreme role in game (e.g., gunfire, explosives, unarmed attacks)
